newsitem.title: HONG KONG: PT Texmaco unit allots US$100 mln FRN.
newsitem.headline: PT Texmaco unit allots US$100 mln FRN.

text.p: PT TPE International Finance Co's US$100 million floating rate note issue has been allotted, arranger Sumitomo Finance Asia said.
The deal is guaranteed by Texmaco Perkasa Engineering.
The facility has a final maturity of five years with a put and a call option in year three. The issue was priced at par to float at 300 basis points over the six-month London Interbank Offered Rate.
Fees are 135 basis points for co-lead managers and 110 basis points for managers.
Arrangers and lead managers are Sumitomo Finance Asia, Bank Negara Indonesia Hong Kong, BT Asia, Overseas Union Bank, Peregrine Fixed Income and Seoulbank.
Co-arrangers are Bank NISP, KMBC Asia and Ssangyong Investment and Securities Co Ltd.
Co-lead managers are Painewebber International UK and Gyongnam Merchant Banking Corp.
Managers are Asahi Finance Hong Kong, Coryo Merchant Bank, HanGil Merchant Banking Corp, Shinhan Investment Bank and Staco International Finance.
